_note: v2.8 plan 60 B6 (no-model lane): a checkpoint cast_changes write is announced to ST: one GROUP_UPDATED per saved write, and the open group's member row for the changed member toggles its .disabled class (ST's own member list), then back on the re-enabling checkpoint. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-60-b6-cast-announce.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); const chid = ctx.characters.findIndex((c) => c.name === 'Arin'); if (chid < 0) throw new Error('Arin is not a character here'); const events = []; const listener = (...args) => events.push({ at: Date.now(), arg: typeof args[0] === 'string' ? args[0] : null }); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GROUP_UPDATED, listener); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const row = () => { const el = document.querySelector('.rm_group_members .group_member[data-chid="' + chid + '"]'); return el ? { present: true, disabled: el.classList.contains('disabled') } : { present: false, disabled: null }; }; const stored = () => { const group = ctx.groups.find((g) => g.id === ctx.groupId); return (group?.disabled_members ?? []).includes(ctx.characters[chid].avatar); }; globalThis.__b6 = { chid, events, listener, pause, row, stored }; return { chid, row: row(), storedDisabled: stored() };

import_story.title: SO-V28-60 B6
import_story.description: Plan 60 B6 no-model fixture: Arin leaves at one checkpoint and returns at the next.

steps.eval: const b = globalThis.__b6; globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await b.pause(1500); const r = b.row(); if (!r.present) throw new Error('ST member list row for Arin is not rendered, so the DOM half cannot be checked'); if (r.disabled || b.stored()) throw new Error('Arin starts disabled'); b.events.length = 0; return { row: r };

const b = globalThis.__b6; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (!(await rt.activateCheckpoint('away'))) throw new Error('away did not activate'); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !(b.row().disabled && b.stored()); i += 1) await b.pause(150); await b.pause(1200); const r = b.row(); const count = b.events.length; if (!b.stored()) throw new Error('the group does not hold Arin as disabled'); if (!r.disabled) throw new Error('ST member row did not show Arin as disabled: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); if (count !== 1) throw new Error('expected exactly one GROUP_UPDATED for the cast write, got ' + count + ': ' + JSON.stringify(b.events)); const groupId = SillyTavern.getContext().groupId; if (b.events[0].arg !== null && b.events[0].arg !== groupId) throw new Error('GROUP_UPDATED named another group: ' + b.events[0].arg); b.events.length = 0; return { row: r, groupUpdated: count, arg: b.events[0]?.arg ?? groupId };

const b = globalThis.__b6; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (!(await rt.activateCheckpoint('back'))) throw new Error('back did not activate'); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && (b.row().disabled || b.stored()); i += 1) await b.pause(150); await b.pause(1200); const r = b.row(); const count = b.events.length; if (b.stored() || r.disabled) throw new Error('Arin is still disabled after the re-enabling checkpoint: ' + JSON.stringify({ r, stored: b.stored() })); if (count !== 1) throw new Error('expected exactly one GROUP_UPDATED for the re-enable, got ' + count); return { row: r, groupUpdated: count };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GROUP_UPDATED, globalThis.__b6.listener); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await globalThis.__b6.pause(800); return { authorView: false };
